title: Write a local SEO page brief
description: Identify search intent and outline a useful local service page.
prompt:
Act as a marketing strategist.

Task: Write a local SEO page brief.

Input context:
- SERVICE: [SERVICE]
- CITY: [CITY]
- CUSTOMERS: [CUSTOMERS]
- CONFIRMED DETAILS: [CONFIRMED DETAILS]

Identify search intent and outline a useful local service page. Include title, headings, practical information, questions and evidence requirements. Use only genuine service areas and avoid duplicate city pages, invented search volumes or ranking guarantees.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Rabat workshop page brief
Explain the activity, intended level, confirmed location, schedule and how to enquire. Answer equipment and accessibility questions using verified details. Add original local information rather than exchanging city names in identical copy. Measure actual Search Console queries and qualified requests later; this example supplies no keyword-volume estimate or expected ranking.
useCases: Prepare a reviewable deliverable: write a local seo page brief.
Compare assumptions, evidence and practical next steps before taking action.
tips: Provide concrete, authorised context for service before using this prompt.
